release_notes: Every function, looked at one at a time. This release is the result of a function-by-function review of the whole application: each route pressed, each service read, the arithmetic re-derived from the ledger, and the native shells on both platforms examined separately. It found real defects in places the test suite had been happy with for months — GST booked twice on a debtors settlement, an audit pack that failed the day after it was sealed, a PDF whose last page repeated the page before it — and they are fixed here, each with a test that would have caught it. A native Windows beta. …
